paper.title: Plug in the Safety Chip: Enforcing Constraints for LLM-driven Robot Agents
paper.central_claim: 可插拔、可查询的 LTL 安全约束模块（NL→LTL 编码、违规推理与解释、不安全动作剪枝）能让 LLM 机器人代理严格遵守安全约束，并随约束复杂度扩展，在 VirtualHome 与真机 Spot 上验证。

evidence.quote: we propose a queryable safety constraint module based on linear temporal logic (LTL) that simultaneously enables natural language (NL) to temporal constraints encoding, safety violation reasoning and explaining, and unsafe action pruning
evidence.support_explanation: 中心主张：LTL 安全约束模块（NL→LTL、违规解释、不安全动作剪枝）。

evidence.quote: our system strictly adheres to the safety constraints and scales well with complex safety constraints
evidence.support_explanation: 作者结论："严格遵守"并"可扩展"。

evidence.quote: The representation is then verified by the human for correctness.
evidence.support_explanation: LTL 须由人工专家校验，是保证的前提。

evidence.quote: causing the agent to likely choose an action within the same distribution of the masked unsafe action since its distribution remains unchanged
evidence.support_explanation: 作者论证仅屏蔽不够，需要 reprompt 解释（未做 mask-only 消融）。

evidence.quote: assuming we have perfect truth value functions and transition model, any violation of the safety constraints can be detected in advance
evidence.support_explanation: 保证依赖完美命题真值函数与转移模型。

evidence.quote: During the experiment, we access the simulator for information such as locations and states of objects for truth values.
evidence.support_explanation: 实验中命题真值来自仿真器特权状态。

evidence.quote: We adopted 20 household tasks from two environments
evidence.support_explanation: 评测任务 20 个。

evidence.quote: Task difficulty is controlled as each task is accompanied by an in-context example that has the exact ground truth action sequence with only the goal specification paraphrased
evidence.support_explanation: 每个任务的上下文示例含精确 GT 动作序列，只改写目标，任务难度被人为压低。

evidence.quote: if ever the agent violates the safety constraints and enters an invalid state specified by the automaton
evidence.support_explanation: 安全率由同一自动机判定：与强制执行用同一个检查器（循环验证）。

evidence.quote: Base Model 90% 38% 94% 30% NL Constraints 100% 56% 100% 56% NL Constraints ∗ 100% 54% 96% 62%
evidence.support_explanation: VirtualHome 基线：成功/安全率（Four Room、Mobile Manipulation）。

evidence.quote: Safety Chip 76% 84% 88% 94% Safety Chip ∗ 98% 100% 98% 100%
evidence.support_explanation: Safety Chip（未校验 LTL）成功 76/88、安全 84/94；专家校验后 98/100、98/100。

evidence.quote: even without expert verification, there is still a large margin over the other baselines, though the success rate is affected because of the mistranslated safety constraints
evidence.support_explanation: 误翻译使成功率下降：人工校验是性能前提。

evidence.quote: we observed that the success rate of Base Model is lower than the other two agents that have access to the safety constraints
evidence.support_explanation: 作者自陈约束提供有用信息，基线间信息量不同。

evidence.quote: each task is run twice, and the temperature of the LLM is set to zero
evidence.support_explanation: 真机每任务仅运行两次，温度 0，无方差。

evidence.quote: we assume no mistranslation in LTL formulas verified by the experts and no mechanical failure in the experiment
evidence.support_explanation: 真机实验假设翻译无误且无机械故障。

evidence.quote: Code as Policies 53% 55% NL Constraints 98% 34% Safety Chip 98% 100%
evidence.support_explanation: 真机：成功率/安全率，分母未给。

evidence.quote: When the number of constraints surpasses five, we observe a drastic decrease in the safety rate for the two baselines: NL Constraints achieves 0%, and Code as Policies achieves 40%.
evidence.support_explanation: 约束超过五条时基线安全率骤降，支撑"可扩展"。

evidence.quote: three task abortion tests with safety constraints contradicting the task itself are conducted
evidence.support_explanation: 矛盾约束下中止测试仅 3 次。

evidence.quote: Huang et al. [24] has touched on the safety topic by providing a neural network-based safety module in parallel with affordance and human preference modules together as scoring functions
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻之一：SayCan 式 NN 安全模块。

evidence.quote: give the user detailed feedback about what constraints are violated
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻 Raman et al. 的 LTL 违规反馈做法；无定量对比。

evidence.quote: LTL lacks expressivity as compared to natural language
evidence.support_explanation: LTL 表达力局限。

evidence.quote: The noteworthy distinction is that our translation module relies solely on in-context learning and necessitates no fine-tuning
evidence.support_explanation: NL→LTL 翻译仅靠上下文学习（基于 Lang2LTL）。

evidence.quote: to test the hypothesis that our safety chip approach can reduce the frequency of safety constraint violations without decreasing the frequency of task completion relative to the base models without a safety chip
evidence.support_explanation: 预先陈述的假设：降低违规且不降低完成率。

evidence.quote: detailed example tasks could be found in Appendix -E
evidence.support_explanation: 附录 A-F（提示词、示例任务、CaP 实现）被引用但不在材料包内。

evidence.quote: although actually meeting those standards is beyond the scope of this work
evidence.support_explanation: ISO 61508 合规不在本文范围。

signatures.object: 位于 LLM 代理与执行器之间的安全约束监控器：LTL 自动机+查询系统
signatures.information: 人工 NL 安全约束→经 Lang2LTL 式上下文翻译成 LTL→人工校验→组合成自动机；每步由仿真器特权状态给出命题真值（假设完美真值函数）；LLM 代理本身只见提示
signatures.operation: 把代理提议动作推进自动机；若会进入不可接受状态则屏蔽；查询系统（GPT-4）依据约束、违规动作、状态变化生成违规原因，作为错误信息附到提示后让代理重新生成动作
signatures.output: 放行动作或"拒绝+自然语言原因"
signatures.conditions: 约束为 LTL 可表达的 avoidance/trigger 模式；命题词表预定义；人工专家可校验公式
signatures.feedback: 违规解释文本回灌提示（reprompt）
signatures.selection_rule: 确定性：自动机接受性；解释生成不参与判定
signatures.persistence: 自动机状态在 episode 内随命题真值推进；约束库跨任务可复用
signatures.claimed_effect: 专家校验 LTL 下安全率 100%，成功率不降（98%）
signatures.failure_boundary: 误翻译；真值函数不完美；LTL 表达力；矛盾约束需中止；约束 >5 时基线崩溃但本法仅在小样本验证

signatures.object: NL 约束→LTL 翻译与人工核验流程
signatures.information: 预定义词表；参照表达抽取→接地到命题→提升语句→公式→回代
signatures.operation: 仅靠上下文学习的模块化翻译，约束按 AND 组合
signatures.conditions: 约束是基础片段的合取；有懂 LTL 的专家
signatures.claimed_effect: 验证比重写 LTL 更容易
signatures.failure_boundary: 未校验时误翻译使成功率下降（76% vs 98%）

gap.author_gap: LLM 代理概率性、难以稳定遵守安全约束，约束变复杂时更差且会分散原任务；现有代理依赖预训练 affordance 反馈模块，难以泛化/按用户偏好定制；"don'ts" 研究不足。
gap.checked_gap: 正文基线结果支持该 gap：NL 约束基线安全率仅 54-62%，真机约束>5 时降至 0%（E010,E017）。最近邻已列：SayCan 式 NN 安全模块、Vemprala 代码+仿真+人审、PDDL 方法、Raman 等 LTL 反馈、Lang2LTL（E019,E020）；但与这些近邻无定量对比。

lineage_closest_adjacent.lineage: 运行时验证/LTL 监控（Kress-Gazit, Raman 等）+ Lang2LTL（NL→LTL）+ SayCan/LLM-Planner 代理 → 本文把 LTL 自动机作为外挂安全门并用 LLM 解释回灌

Huang et al. [24] 神经网络安全模块 (文中引用，原文未固定)

gap.residue: 形式化可验证的约束执行与 LLM 灵活性如何结合；runtime 违规发生后如何让 LLM 重新规划而不陷入同一分布。
gap.stakes: 工业/医护场景的安全合规（ISO 61508 类）；违规一次即不可接受。
gap.method_response: LTL 自动机做确定性判定+屏蔽；LLM 仅负责解释与重生成；专家校验保障公式正确。
gap.remaining_gap: 保证依赖完美真值函数与专家校验；词表预定义；无 mask-only/去解释消融；成本未知；真机规模极小；与 Raman 式 LTL 反馈基线无对比。

matches.tactic_steps_checked: C25 tactic：LLM 输出可机检的中间产物(LTL 公式/违规状态变化)→路由到 sound 机制(自动机)→用其可验证输出闭环(屏蔽+解释回灌，在构建过程中而非事后)——执行(step1 接缝清楚:LLM 翻译/解释，自动机判定；step2 产物为形式化 LTL；step3 违规判定在生成中闭环)。step4 承重机制消融：未做(mask-only vs reprompt 缺)；step5 成本：未报。
matches.success_failure_checks: success：typed 可验证中间产物(met)；闭环信号可得(partial：真值来自仿真特权)；单一承重机制消融(unmet)。failure：成本未测(命中)；仅小基准手写(partial：20 任务+2 真机任务)；marginal 胜过统一基线(未命中：安全率差距大，但基线信息量不同)。
matches.reason: 操作确为将 LLM 与形式化自动机分工并闭环，而非仅提及；C25 的"可机检中间产物+solver 闭环"在此成立。

rs_pattern.reason: 主操作=LLM 生成形式化约束+确定性自动机裁决+违规解释回灌，对应分解委托。

executes_pattern.reason: 形式化中间产物、sound 裁决、在线闭环回灌均实际执行；缺少承重机制消融与成本。

resolves_problem.reason: 在专家校验 LTL+完美真值的前提下，约束被满足由构造保证；对"LLM 不可靠"问题的关闭仅限于所表达的约束，且安全率由同一自动机度量。

claims.text: 专家校验 LTL 后 Safety Chip 在两组 VirtualHome 实验中安全率 100%，成功率 98%，显著高于 NL 约束(54-62%)与基线(30-38%)
claims.setting: VirtualHome，20 家居任务，每任务 1-5 条约束；GPT-4-0613
claims.baseline_control: 同一 GPT-4 基础代理：无约束 Base、NL 约束、专家重写 NL 约束
claims.selection_vs_test: 无开发/测试划分说明；每个任务附带含精确 GT 动作序列的示例
claims.result_denominator: 分母（运行次数）未在正文给出；表中为"平均"值
claims.counterevidence: 安全率由同一自动机判定且真值来自仿真特权，100% 近似构造性结果；基线信息通路不同(E013)；示例含 GT 序列
claims.allowed_conclusion: 在公式正确且命题真值完美时，所执行动作前缀满足所写约束，且不损伤完成率；不能推出更一般的"LLM 代理安全"
